name: learn
whenToInvoke: When asked about past patterns, or proactively after completing a session. Every session should end with learnings captured.
workflow:
1. Run 'mia learn list' to see existing
2. Add new: 'mia learn add <skill> <type> <key> <insight>'
3. Types: pattern, pitfall, preference, architecture, tool, constitutional-principle, character-trait, psychological-insight
4. Confidence auto-decays 1pt per 30 days

constitutionalAlignment.reasoning: Learning system embodies 'reflective equilibrium' and 'psychological security'. Decay prevents stale knowledge; confidence scores enable 'verification over confidence'. Primary value: Ethical (honest, self-aware).
